findings.title: Unknown-effect receipt fallback throws under StrictMode
findings.evidence: TIMED_OUT/CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE result contains receipt_path and receipt_digest, not artifact_path/artifact_digest. Wrapper accesses optional artifact properties before its fallback. Under Set-StrictMode Latest a pure fixture produces PropertyNotFoundStrict.
findings.impact: The wrapper discards structured unknown-effect/receipt readback metadata precisely when the executed effect cannot be considered complete. The caller receives a generic failure instead of the durable receipt identity.
findings.required_fix: Select fields through PSObject.Properties or schema-normalize result variants before optional access. Add timeout, capture-incomplete, replay and exception-shaped metadata fixtures through the actual wrapper response projection.

findings.title: The binding combines disk raw bytes with a different normalized Git blob
findings.evidence: Disk SHA256853b… and raw --no-filters Git blob bca51b… match CRLF bytes; tree entry c2658d… is 14 LF bytes with SHA2564d5695…. Binding associates the disk SHA with the LF blob.
findings.impact: This is not one consistent raw-byte/tree identity. Publication from disk and publication from tree can disagree, undermining an exact-source verdict.
findings.required_fix: Use the authoritative Git tree blob bytes to compute raw SHA256, or create the raw tree with explicit no-filter bytes. Label any normalized projection separately. Preserve the old binding as historical.
